summary: the forge's merge settings, and the merge that obeys them

args.name: --tsv
args.help: the same reconciliation as rows (status/key/detail/remedy) — for a reader that is a program, as yoga prerequisites is

sends: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo} — reads the live settings (bare, sync, merge)
gh pr list --state all — reads every PR (bare, merge, prune)
gh repo view — reads the default branch
git remote prune --dry-run origin — asks the remote which tracking refs are gone
